thread:
jess: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of invoice-preview deltas after we rolled routing-proxy v2 to 5% canary this morning. ~33 tenants affected, small $ impact but reproducible.

ryan: Repro steps? token surge or duplicated events?

jess: Duplicate metering emits. Traced one request: proxy attempted primary route then fallback and emitted two metering events with different request ids.

priya: so downstream sees two unique request_ids -> counts twice. do clients send an idempotency header? we normally rely on X-Request-ID.

jess: yes clients often send X-Request-ID, but proxy fallback path currently generates a fresh id instead of reusing the incoming header. sample logs:

``
2026-03-21T08:42:10Z proxy-v2 INFO recv tenant=foo req_id=xrid-9 route=primary
2026-03-21T08:42:10Z proxy-v2 WARN fallback to route-alt generated req_id=xrid-9-fb
2026-03-21T08:42:10Z metering-producer INFO emit tenant=foo req_id=xrid-9 tokens=120
2026-03-21T08:42:10Z metering-producer INFO emit tenant=foo req_id=xrid-9-fb tokens=120
```

oliver: Fix options: 1) preserve X-Request-ID in proxy fallback (fast, source-of-truth fix), 2) add short-window dedupe in metering ingest (safer but heavier), 3) post-process invoice-preview diffs to ignore likely dups for now.

priya: prefer 1) + add conservative dedupe as safety for noncompliant clients. dedupe should be exact match on (tenant, request_id) with TTL 90s and only for non-streaming.

carla: UI/console impact — support will flag spike. can we surface a temporary metric routing.fallback.count and link to the request trace from invoice-preview?

jess: yes — will add metric and a small feature-flagged console card showing fallback rate by route and top tenants.

ryan: roll plan? revert canary now or quick patch?

jess: reverting to stop new noise. patch PR in flight to preserve header and add unit tests. will shadow canary once validated.

ops-bot: canary deployment routing-proxy v2 started at 2026-03-21T08:40:00Z (cluster: canary-eu-central)

jess: revert initiated. ops-bot should post when drained.

ops-bot: revert routing-proxy v2 canary started at 2026-03-21T08:45:00Z — draining traffic.

oliver: After fix, please add a tiny field on metering events: upstream_origin=proxy|edge|sdk. that'll help filter these cases in analytics without changing downstream billing semantics.

priya: ingest dedupe design note: only dedupe exact (tenant, request_id) matches, TTL 90s, only for non-streaming RPCs. make it opt-in via config flag per cluster to avoid cross-region state issues.

carla: product ok with console card behind feature flag and short explainer for affected customers. I will draft support blurb.

jess: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing-proxy/pull/1740 — header-preserve + integration test. ETA shadow canary tomorrow after +6h soak in staging.

ryan: schedule a quick invoice-preview backfill compare after shadow run. if deltas are gone we can unflag.

jess: thanks all — closing for now, will reopen if we see diff regressions. if anyone else notices unexplained invoice-preview spikes, ping me directly.
